sources.citation: Grimes, Charles E. & Owen Edwards. 2025 [imprint 2026]. The Austronesian languages of eastern Indonesia and Timor-Leste: unravelling their prehistory and classification. Berlin: Language Science Press. Sec. 3.3.1.1 'Sumba phonology' pp.140-142; Table 3.50; sec. 3.4.3; Appendix A.1 p.732.
sources.note: Family-level only, p.141: 'Languages of Sumba have vowel epenthesis.. The epenthetic vowel is extra-metrical and does not shift stress from the penultimate vowel of the root' (examples Kambera, Weyewa, Mamboru, Kodi). Nothing specific to Baliledo/Pondok; Appendix A.1 lists no data source for either lect.

sources.citation: Lovestrand, Joseph. 2021. Languages of Sumba: state of the field. NUSA 70: 39-60.
sources.note: Nothing for Baliledu/Ponduk (mentioned only via Asplund 2010: possibly separate languages, retain /s/, lack prenasalised stops). Sec. 4.2 p.48 stress remarks (lengthening of stressed, typically penultimate, vowels) are for Weyewa/Kodi and Kambera/Laboya.

sources.note: Nothing. Notes define vowel-length notation only ('short vowels: à, ì, ù, è, ò; long vowels: a, í, ú, e, o'); no stress marks or statement.

sources.citation: Soelarto, B. [n.d., ca. 1977]. Pustaka Budaya Sumba, Jilid I. Jakarta: Proyek Pengembangan Media Kebudayaan, Direktorat Jenderal Kebudayaan, Departemen Pendidikan dan Kebudayaan. 105 pp. (Repositori Kemdikbud item 5908 'Budaya Sumba jilid 1'; Google Books lists the combined 216-pp edition as Bambang Sularto 1977 'Pustaka budaya Sumba').
sources.note: Nothing. The whole volume was text-searched (scanned text present): tekanan, aksen, accent, stress, intonasi, nada all 0 hits. Section E gives only segmental folk-phonology for other logat (Kambera and Kodi pronounce s as h, 'kabisu' > 'kabihu'; Wewewa and Laora s > z; Mamboro, Laoli, Anakalang, Lamboya keep s; Kambera lacks palatals nj/j/ny; root-final consonants h k l ng r s t take an added vowel, West Sumba -a/-o, East Sumba -u, e.g. Kodi bandalo, Mamboro banjala, Kambera bijalu), no word classes or gender, plus short comparative word tables (Kodi / Wewewa / Anakalang / Kambera). For Pondu…
